Course Calendar (all dates approximate)

Week 1:
  • Review of resonance; conjugation
  • Kinetic vs. thermodynamic control, 1,2- vs 1,4-addition
Week 2:
  • Diels–Alder reaction (endo rule)
Wk 3
  - Aromaticity: Hückel's rule, 4n+2, annulenes
  - Heterocycles (pyridine, pyrrole)
Wk 4
  - EAS: halogenation, nitration, sulfonation
  - Friedel-Crafts alkylation & acylation
W5 Exam 1 (Weeks 1-4)
W6 SNAr and benzyne
Week 7: NMR spectroscopy, IR, mass spec
Week 8: Grignard reagents, Wittig reaction
